detail: Baton needs M03's brief docs/milestones/M03.md on main with a fenced block under "## Copy-ready session prompt". The brief is on main, but no complete fenced block follows that heading. Add the heading and fenced block, then commit it on main: git -C "@TMP@/Fixture" add -- "docs/milestones/M03.md" && git -C "@TMP@/Fixture" commit -m "Record M03 brief"
